verdict.rationale: Navan's API documents batch management of custom-field option values with async job-status polling, which is a real first-party bulk operation. It is narrow, though. Expense and transaction endpoints are only described as retrieve/update, and the MCP examples are read-only queries across many items, not bulk actions. Missing for 10: bulk update/approve/categorize of expenses or transactions, bulk actions via MCP, documented batch limits or semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
